question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.

The boy found the project to be a peice of cake because it was incredibly easy.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"peice"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"piece"**.

 
 
• **Meaning:** A portion of an object or material. (टुकड़ा)
 
• **Example:** She gave me a** piece **of her mind.
 
 
 
• **"Piece"** refers to a portion or **part of an object or material.** (टुकड़ा)
 
 
• **Example:** He took a piece of bread from the basket.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "piece".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Praject** (प्रोजेक्ट): Incorrect spelling of **"project"**.

 
 
• **Example:** The **project **was due next week.
 
 
 
• **Incrediblly** (अविश्वसनीय): Incorrect spelling of **"incredibly"**.
 
 
• **Example:** The show was **incredibly** entertaining.
 
 
 
• **Foaund** (पाया): Incorrect spelling of **"found"**.
 
 
• **Example:** He** found** a coin on the street.
